tools.name: gauntlet_start
tools.description: Use this when the user wants their own agent tested on everyday jobs with planted traps, refereed from the end state. tools.name: gauntlet_act
tools.description: Use this during a Gauntlet run to call one sandbox tool in the current job. Inputs: gauntlet_id, tool and args. Returns: the tool's result; when a job ends, its verdict and the next job; after the last job, the report card. Limits: each job's tool-call limit (in limits); only the sandbox is touched.

tools.name: gauntlet_status
tools.description: Use this to see where a Gauntlet run stands. Inputs: gauntlet_id. Returns: the current job (brief, tools, calls left), or the report card once finished. Limits: 60 calls a minute per address.
